facts.fact: Marracuene, in Maputo province, became the first municipality in the country to start postal addressing (naming and numbering streets and buildings, postal codes, toponymic signs and a geographic database), launched on 3 October 2025 by the Ministry of State Administration and Public Service under Decree 74/2024, the Jornal NGANI reports.

systems.owner: municipalities; Ministério da Administração Estatal e Função Pública

facts.fact: INCM presented in Pemba the new eight-digit postal addressing code approved by Decree 74/2024, replacing the Decree 28/2019 model, with gradual implementation planned from 2027.

The Council of Ministers approved a resolution homologating 1,444 geographic names for roads and territorial units in 14 municipalities and one district, to improve the addressing system of cities and towns, says the government spokesman.

systems.owner: Ministries of state administration and of transport and communications

note: The decree fixes the structure of postal codes for territorial units and urban zones; it states no address register, street naming or digital addressing.
